deviations.what: qodo-cli becomes a wrapper over Qodo's MCP server and API: a gateway we control, deciding which upstream tools are exposed and how (proxied as MCP tools, converted to CLI verbs, served over HTTP). The plan had a fixed list of six hand-written verbs over a private client.
deviations.reason: Operator direction after the live probe showed Qodo's server offers 71 tools, including ones that write to pull requests and change rules.

deviations.what: The upstream single-rule read (Qodo's rules-get tool) is the verb 'rules show', not 'rules get' as t5's acceptance criterion says; 'rules get' stays the existing local search verb. 'history file' was renamed 'history show' to match the plan
deviations.reason: 'rules get <query>' already exists as the older search verb and is pinned by contract tests that must pass unchanged, so the name was taken

deviations.what: associate needs a serve verb and token issue/list/revoke verbs, which no plan task builds: t14 built the HTTP app factory and a file token store but nothing starts a listener or issues a token, so culture-rules could not call the associate bridge. Added as extra work on associate's feat/bridge, citing qodo-cli's serve and token verbs
deviations.reason: t14's acceptance criterion says each verb is an HTTP operation behind a token; without serve and tokens that cannot be used, and t20 (deploy) assumes both exist
